events.verdict: RLS shows Prince (ATL) briefly grasps Ellington's (MIA) side during the screen but it does not affect his FOM.
Ricardson (MIA) slightly extends his arms against Prince's (ATL) during the screen but it does not affect his ability to defend.
Young (ATL) legally contests McGruder's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Collins (ATL) makes incidental contact with Richardson (MIA) as they both go for the ball, but doesn't affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Bembry (ATL) cleanly deflects Richardson's (MIA) pass attempt.
McGruder (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball before making incidental contact to Collins' (ATL) body during his shot attempt.
Olynyk (MIA) briefly grasps Bembry's (ATL) arms during the screen but it does not affect his ability to defend through the play.
Bembry (ATL) does not step into Wade's (MIA) landing area during his jump shot attempt.
LAR shows Olynyk (MIA) makes marginal contact with McGruder's (ATL) arm during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
As Olynyk (MIA) releases from the pick, he makes a natural move and makes incidental foot contact with Prince (ATL).
Prince (ATL) makes marginal contact with Ellington (MIA) after his pass that doesn't affect his ability to pass or land safely.
Young (ATL) receives the ball and takes two legal steps.
Richardson (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball before making marginal contact with Bazemore's (MIA) arm during the hand-off.
[Observable in enhanced video] Young (ATL) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Bazemore (ATL) firms up on McGruder's (MIA) shoulder during the screen but it does not affect his ability to defend.
Wade (MIA) legally contests Bembry's (ATL) jump shot attempt and does not move through his body as he lands. Any "high five" contact after the release of the shot is considered incidental.
Bazemore (ATL) cleanly blocks McGruder's (MIA) drive shot attempt.
Bembry (ATL) makes contact with Richardson (MIA)'s hand but does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Richardson (MIA) unintentionally redirects the ball after the made basket.
Winslow (MIA) commits a take foul on Prince (ATL).
Prince (ATL) briefly grasps Ricardson's (MIA) during the pick but it does not affect his FOM.
Olynyk (MIA) is not established in a legal screening position in Bembry's (ATL) path and does not give him room to avoid the contact.
Richardson (MIA) is moving when he gathers the ball and legally takes two steps.
Bazemore (ATL) cleanly tips the ball away from McGruder (ATL) during the rebound.
